title: Restore local API command contract imports
summary: Restored package-relative imports for both Local API command-contract aggregators so the bundled Python runtime can launch the backend.
reason: A recent refactor changed these imports to a nonexistent top-level src package, causing the Tauri launcher to fail before the WebView opened.
behavior_before: Tauri startup failed during Local API import with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'src'.
behavior_after: The bundled runtime imports both command-contract aggregators, Tauri prerequisites pass, and the shell launch/close smoke succeeds.
manual_validation: Bundled Python imports both command-contract aggregators successfully.
apps/desktop/tauri/Test-TauriShell-Launch.ps1 -Mode Dev passed; shell and backend opened and shut down cleanly.
rollback_plan: Revert the two import-only changes if a supported packaging environment requires a different module layout; no runtime state or media data is changed by this fix.
notes:
Restore package-relative imports so the bundled runtime can load Local API command contracts.
Restore package-relative imports for the desktop Local API command-contract aggregator.
The broad Tauri/facade static suite remains red in pre-existing assertions unrelated to this import repair; the direct import, prereq, and live launch/close proofs pass.
